messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Added a **Game name** field to Reproduce a game. Named snapshots include the name, and loading one restores it. Restart keeps the name; starting a new game clears it. Older snapshots without a name remain compatible.

Snapshot loading now accepts fields in any JSON order while still rejecting unknown fields. Unnamed exports keep their existing format, including replay output.

`git diff --check` passed. I did not run tests or type checks.
